title: Scenario 2: Polar Fuel Shortage Crisis
description: Severe sub-zero storm forces primary base generators and auxiliary heaters to run at 3.5x consumption rate. Days of Autonomy rapidly drop below the next resupply window, generating a CRITICAL resupply risk alert and degrading expedition readiness.

events.reason: Extreme blizzard - auxiliary thermal generators engaged at max load
Sub-zero manifold rupture in secondary fuel bladder
